_comment: Skies that ship inside the mod jar. Add an entry here and drop the sheet into
assets/oyvey/textures/sky to hand out a new sky with the next build.
Sheets use the OptiFine layout: three columns by two rows,
top row bottom/top/east, bottom row south/west/north.
Per layer keys: texture, blend, rotate, speed, axis,

skies.name: Midnight
skies.description: Deep blue night with the milky way arching overhead.

skies.name: Nebula
skies.description: Coloured gas clouds and a dense star field.

skies.name: Aurora
skies.description: Northern lights over a quiet star field.
